d.ko: Grow magical crops—and your own workforce. Run an alchemy shop in a city trapped in a time loop, forge bonds with humans and non-humans, and shape its fate. A dark fantasy management sim with branching stories and multiple endings.
d.en: Grow magical crops—and your own workforce. Run an alchemy shop in a city trapped in a time loop, forge bonds with humans and non-humans, and shape its fate. A dark fantasy management sim with branching stories and multiple endings.
d.zh: 欢迎来到钻石之城！参演无尽回溯的疯狂戏剧吧！在这款种田-炼金-开店的模拟经营+多结局剧情游戏中，你将扮演一位天赋非凡的炼金师，种植神奇植物，与人类和非人类交往，在各种超凡势力中获取声望，体验丰富剧情与模拟经营交织出的幻想旅程。
